## 1. Paste this into Template Manager at import

The `.checklist.json` file holds **only the fields**. These four settings are
entered by hand in the Template Manager import dialog — they are NOT in the file.

| Setting | Value to enter |
|---|---|
| **Navn (Name)** | {{template_name}} |
| **Kode (Code)** | {{template_code}} |
| **Kategori (Category)** | {{template_category}} |
| **Gjeldende prosjekttyper (Applicable project types)** | {{project_types_comma_separated}} |

> **Category note:** the category list is defined per tenant, so the value above
> is a *suggestion*. Pick the matching category from your own list when importing.
>
> **Project-types note:** these were matched against your live BO project types.
> If a name doesn't appear in the import dialog, pick the closest existing one.

## 3. Standards & Compliance Considered

{{For each standard or framework evaluated during the session, one bullet:

- **<Standard name>** — <Applied? Why or why not?>

Examples:

- **Internkontrollforskriften** — Applied. Drives the vernerunde sections on
  fysisk arbeidsmiljø, brann/rømning and kjemikalier.
- **Arbeidsmiljøloven kap. 4** — Applied. Shapes the ergonomi and
  arbeidsmiljø questions.
- **ISO 45001** — Considered, not formally applied (company not certified).
- **GDPR** — Considered. No personal data collected beyond the named
  inspector, so no consent step needed.

Be honest about what was rejected and why.}}

## 5. Challenges Raised in Design

{{For each challenge raised during the consultation, one bullet showing the
question and the user's resolution:

- **Challenge:** "<What was challenged — wrong field type, non-MECE options,
  over-collection, leading question, too many required fields, missing
  evidence capture, etc.>"
  - **Resolution:** "<User's reasoning + final decision>"

Example:

- **Challenge:** "Spørsmålet «Er belysningen god?» er ledende og ja/nei gir
  ingen nyansering. Bør det være et choice-felt med gradering?"
  - **Resolution:** Endret til choice med fire nivåer inkl. «Ikke vurdert».

If no challenges were raised, state "Ingen utfordringer reist — skjemaet var
klart fra starten av."}}
